description: SynVoid v1 qualification policy for Eggbench Security Qualification M002. Maps WAF source `detect|pass` expectations to externally observable HTTP status codes under the supported minimal runtime.
scope: Terminal attack action is configured as `block`
A source fixture with `expected_result = detect` maps to an expected live HTTP block status (403)
A source fixture with `expected_result = pass` maps to the controlled origin's success status (200)
Initial externally observable expectations are HTTP status only
transport_rules: Requests are plain HTTP/1.1 to the loopback listener with the natural Host header (127.0.0.1:<listen-port>); no Host override is required.
The driver MUST send a neutral (non-bot) User-Agent: SynVoid's UA bot stage has no config kill-switch and 403s known-bot UAs (e.g. curl/*) independent of site bot settings.

Corpus paths are stored losslessly; ASCII SP inside a request-target MUST be percent-encoded as %20 on the wire (raw SP is illegal in a request-target). The WAF normalizer decodes %20 before detection, so observable semantics are unchanged.
semantic_change_rule: Any semantic mapping change requires a new policy identifier (new policy_version).
